stops.name: Steinwald
stops.quote: In the Steinwald, mighty granite formations like the Oberpfalzturm or the Weißenstein castle ruins rise above the treetops.
stops.english: In the Steinwald, mighty granite formations like the Oberpfalzturm or the Weißenstein castle ruins rise above the treetops.

stops.name: Waldnaabtal
stops.quote: The Waldnaabtal is particularly refreshing, where the river has carved its way through high granite blocks.

stops.name: Tirschenreuth Pond District
stops.quote: The Tirschenreuth Pond District, known as the 'Land of a Thousand Ponds', offers a unique aquatic landscape.

stops.name: Goldsteig
stops.quote: The Goldsteig trail leads through the varied landscape of the Upper Palatinate Forest.
stops.english: The Goldsteig trail leads through the varied landscape of the Upper Palatinate Forest.

stops.name: Bärnau-Tachov History Park
stops.quote: Cultural history can be experienced at the Bärnau-Tachov History Park, an archaeological open-air museum.
